name: Lost Villa (Moganshan Biwu)

comments.quote: The floor-to-ceiling windows offer a beautiful green view, which was so relaxing. We brought our little cat with us, and it's one of the few pet-friendly places around. The breakfast was also really good! ☺️☺️
comments.author: Guest User

comments.quote: We stayed in a Loft room in building 5, which was very quiet and well-located. It was super convenient to go up the mountain, and a pleasant walk down. The service was excellent, and the staff were all very enthusiastic....
comments.author: Guest User

comments.quote: Very satisfied. Biwu Village is very quiet, and every staff member is very kind. Xiao Hui provided excellent service, and we had a wonderful two-day stay. The room had air conditioning and floor heating, so it wasn't cold at all....
comments.author: Alicejinyu
